definitions: To damage or destroy something by biting and grinding.
To consume or use something completely, often in a destructive way.
To cause someone to feel anxious, worried, or distressed.
examples: The dog chewed up the new toy.
He was chewed up by the experience.
The machine chewed up the documents.
The competition chewed up their profits.
pastTenses: chewed up (simple past), chewed up (past perfect)
